name: Home console
definition: home console on which the owner loads different games from a carrier, card, download or storage.

name: Plug-and-play console
definition: Home console with its games built in, so you cannot load others; includes plug-and-play minis.

name: Handheld console
definition: Handheld on which games are loaded, not built in. A handheld gaming PC counts here.

name: Hybrid console
definition: Console that works both docked to a TV and as a handheld.

name: LCD handheld game
definition: Handheld with its one game built in on an LCD screen.

name: Standalone VR headset
definition: Headset that encloses the eyes and has its own computer and battery.

name: Tethered VR headset
definition: Headset that encloses the eyes and needs a console or PC to run it.

name: Upright arcade cabinet
definition: Coin-operated video arcade cabinet that stands upright and is played standing.

name: Cabaret arcade cabinet
definition: Smaller upright coin-operated video cabinet.

name: Cocktail table arcade cabinet
definition: Coin-operated video cabinet built as a table, played seated across or beside it.

name: Sit-down arcade cabinet
definition: Coin-operated video cabinet with a seat for the player.

name: Cockpit arcade cabinet
definition: Enclosed or motion cabinet built around the player.

name: Bar-top arcade cabinet
definition: Small cabinet made to stand on a counter or bar.

name: Disk-drive add-on
definition: unit that adds a disk drive to a console.

name: Cartridge converter
definition: unit that lets a console play cartridges of another system or region.

name: Gamepad
definition: hand-held controller with a directional pad, buttons and sticks or triggers, held in both hands.

name: Detachable split controller
definition: controller made as two detachable halves that can be used apart.

name: Arcade stick
definition: Arcade-style controller with a joystick lever and buttons.

name: Racing wheel
definition: steering-wheel controller for driving games.

name: Pedal set
definition: set of foot pedals sold as a controller.

name: Light gun
definition: gun-shaped pointing controller.

name: Motion controller
definition: controller that senses its own movement in the player's hand.

name: Console camera
definition: camera made to track the player as game input.

name: Rhythm instrument controller
definition: controller shaped like a musical instrument, made to control a game.

name: Dance or balance mat
definition: floor mat or board that reads the player's steps or weight as game input.

name: Leverless controller
definition: Arcade-style controller with all-button directional input and no lever.

name: Game disc
definition: game on an optical disc.

name: Game cartridge
definition: game on a cartridge holding memory chips.

name: Game card
definition: game on a small flash-memory card.

name: Cassette or floppy game
definition: Game on a cassette, floppy or disk-system card.

name: Game-key card
definition: Physical card that holds only a key to download a game, not the game itself.

name: Download-code card
definition: card or box that unlocks one game as a download.

name: Digital game
definition: Full game downloaded from a console or PC store, held with no disc or cartridge.

name: Expansion
definition: downloadable content that adds a large part to a base game.

name: Add-on pack
definition: Downloadable maps, levels, characters, artbook or wallpaper content for a game.

name: Game mod
definition: modification that adds to or changes one game.

name: Case or pouch
definition: case or pouch made to hold or protect one game machine.

name: Screen protector film
definition: film for the screen of one game machine.

name: Replacement battery pack
definition: Rechargeable battery pack made for one game machine or controller.

name: AC adapter
definition: power adapter made for one game machine.

name: Charging stand
definition: Stand or dock that only charges the machine or controller.

name: Console cable or adapter
definition: Cable or adapter with a connector made for one console.

name: Console memory card
definition: Memory card, drive or expansion in a format made only for one console.

name: TV dock
definition: dock that gives video output to a TV as well as charging.

name: Console stand or mount
definition: Stand or mount made to hold one game machine.

name: Multitap
definition: unit that adds controller ports to a console.

name: Cheat device
definition: Cartridge or unit that alters a game (Game Genie type).

name: Replacement part or repair tool
definition: spare part or tool for repairing a game machine or controller.

name: Flight stick
definition: joystick controller for flight games.

name: Faceplate, skin or decal
definition: cover plate, skin or decal that changes the outside of one game machine or controller.

name: Toys-to-Life portal
definition: Portal or reader that reads Toys-to-Life figures for a game.

name: Hardware upgrade add-on
definition: Unit that plugs into a console to add processor, graphics or memory hardware so it runs games made for the upgraded system (32X type).

name: Console network adapter
definition: Adapter that adds a dial-up modem, broadband or wireless network connection to one console through its own port or bay. A standard USB network adapter is in Computers & Components.

name: Game microphone
definition: Microphone made and sold to plug into a console as game input, for singing or voice commands. A headset is in Audio & Video; a speech microphone sold for computers is in Computers & Components.

name: Console media add-on
definition: Remote control, playback kit or TV tuner made to add disc, video or TV functions to one console.

name: Console mouse
definition: Mouse or trackball made to plug into one console as pointing input. A mouse with a standard connector sold for computers is in Computers & Components.

name: Console keyboard
definition: Keyboard made to plug into one console for typing, programming or text entry in games. A keyboard with a standard connector is in Computers & Components.

name: Paddle or spinner controller
definition: Controller with a rotary knob whose turn sets a position on screen (paddle, spinner, Vaus type).

name: Phone VR viewer
definition: Headset that encloses the eyes and holds a phone as its screen and computer.

name: Rumble pack
definition: Add-on that plugs into one console's controller to make it vibrate (Rumble Pak, Jump Pack, Vibration Pack).

name: Arcade system board
definition: Circuit board, with its game ROMs or cartridge or disc slot, that runs games inside a coin-operated video cabinet (JAMMA, Naomi, Atomiswave, MVS type).

name: Controller converter
definition: Dongle, adapter or board that translates a controller's signals so it works on a console or computer it was not made for. A plain cable is a console cable or adapter.

name: Gear shifter
definition: Lever controller sold apart from a wheel that changes gear in driving games (H-pattern or sequential).

name: Handbrake controller
definition: Lever controller sold apart from a wheel that works the handbrake in driving games.

name: Racing wheelbase
definition: Force-feedback motor base sold without a rim; interchangeable rims mount on it by quick release. Drive type (direct, belt, gear) varies.

name: Tabletop electronic game
definition: Game machine with its game built in and its own screen (VFD, LCD or LED), made to stand on a table, not held and not linked to a TV.

name: Console cooling unit
definition: External fan, cooling stand or clip-on unit made to cool one console. A replacement internal fan is a replacement part.

name: Flight yoke
definition: controller with a yoke handle on a column that pushes, pulls and turns, made for flying aircraft in games and simulators; sold alone or packed with a throttle.

name: Flight throttle
definition: Lever unit sold apart from a stick or yoke that sets engine power, often with flap or trim levers, in flight games and simulators. A stick-and-throttle set (HOTAS) is a flight stick.

name: Sim cockpit or wheel stand
definition: Frame, stand or seat rig made to hold a racing wheel, pedals, shifter or flight controls for play. A gaming chair without controller mounts is in Furniture & Storage.

name: Flash cartridge
definition: cartridge that loads game images from a memory card so they run on original console hardware.

name: Flight-sim control panel
definition: panel of switches, knobs, displays or MFD bezels that sends cockpit inputs to a flight simulator.
